revisionAttributionNote: Revision identities come from the root qualification record; the retained TAP itself contains no argv or revision stamp.
method: Read retained top-level TAP subtest names without executing tests.
Match each name to an exact literal or interpolated test-name declaration in the 18 source files; record source line and observed interpolation values.
Inspect declaration loops and fixture metadata to derive per-file counts independently of execution.
Read the local tests/ helper import closure; no imported helper has a node:test import or top-level test declaration.
Read git diff to verify selected test sources are unchanged from the reported product qualification revision to the final documentation revision.
limitations: This reconstructs a file set explaining all 278 observed tests, not the original argv, environment, test flags, shell globs or scheduling configuration.
TAP names alone cannot exclude an original wrapper/import aggregator or additional input files that registered zero tests.
The proposed rerun command is new and explicit; its reporter/concurrency flags are chosen for recording a fresh qualification and are not inferred historical flags.
Name matching is static text analysis with manually checked loop cardinalities, not execution or a general JavaScript evaluator.

proposedRerun.instruction: Root may execute after its current serial CI job and must retain actual argv, revision, environment and exit status alongside a fresh TAP artifact.
